# ui::TextHighlight

Header: `winui/render/TextLayout.hpp`.

A range drawn with its own background and/or foreground, such as a highlight or the selection.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `begin` | `std::size_t` | `0` | First byte offset into [TextLayout::text()](text-layout.md#text). |
| `end` | `std::size_t` | `0` | One past the last byte offset; an empty range draws nothing. |
| `background` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | [Fill](../layout/fill.md#uifill) behind the range; unset leaves the background alone. |
| `foreground` | `std::optional<Color>` |  | [Text](../controls/text.md#uitext) color inside the range; unset keeps the runs' own colors. |
